reviewer_assignment.default_reviewer_rule: Use the mapped reviewer list first, then fall back to the dashboard owner if no reviewer is explicitly configured.
reviewer_assignment.manager_escalation_rule: Escalate first to the mapping manager list; if none is configured, fall back to the assigned reviewer.
reviewer_assignment.department_lead_escalation_rule: Escalate second to the mapping department-lead list; if none is configured, fall back to the manager list.

approval_workflow.approve_rule: Approval keeps the dashboard as source of truth and may complete the related required item only through the dashboard-controlled review action.
approval_workflow.reject_rule: Rejection is durable and visible, but it does not delete the upload receipt or hide the reviewer decision.
approval_workflow.revision_request_rule: Revision requests move the submission into waiting_on_client so reminders and escalations stay suppressed until the next valid receipt arrives.
approval_workflow.completion_rule: Only approved or rejected submissions are terminal. Under review, unmatched, and revision-requested submissions stay in the operational backlog.
approval_workflow.audit_rule: Every reviewer assignment, exception-state change, escalation, and decision records audit plus intake-event history.

exception_states.label: Active Review
exception_states.suppression_rule: No suppression; reminders and escalations can continue normally.
exception_states.operator_use: Use when the submission still needs normal reviewer handling.

exception_states.label: Waiting On Client
exception_states.suppression_rule: Suppress reminder and escalation automation for the current submission until a new receipt or reviewer action changes the state.
exception_states.operator_use: Use after a revision request or any known client follow-up delay.

exception_states.label: Paused
exception_states.suppression_rule: Suppress reminders and escalations while the record is intentionally paused for internal reasons.
exception_states.operator_use: Use when staffing or scheduling needs a temporary hold.

exception_states.label: Manual Override
exception_states.suppression_rule: Suppress automation and require an explicit operator note describing the exception path.
exception_states.operator_use: Use only when leadership or platform operations has approved a manual workaround.

alerting_and_digests.teams_alerts_channel_rule: Use the governed Teams Automation Alerts routes for overdue-review alerts, escalations, and daily summary visibility.

daily_digest.rule: Queue one digest per tenant day with open backlog, overdue, and escalated counts when any open intake risk exists.

alerting_and_digests.failure_visibility_rule: Escalation or digest failures must remain visible in intake events, diagnostics, and Microsoft integration diagnostics.

backlog_views.review_queue_rule: Show all non-terminal submissions that are not in an exception state.
backlog_views.overdue_rule: Show non-terminal submissions past their review_due_at while exception state is none.
backlog_views.exception_queue_rule: Show waiting_on_client, paused, and manually_overridden submissions separately from the normal review queue.
backlog_views.escalation_queue_rule: Show submissions with escalation_level greater than zero in a dedicated escalation lane.

execution_order.title: Apply the Phase 6 migration and confirm Phase 5 intake plus Phase 4 mail automation diagnostics are healthy.
execution_order.rollback: Disable the Phase 6 feature flag if the migration or validation fails.

execution_order.title: Configure reviewer, manager, and department-lead ownership on active mappings.
execution_order.rollback: Clear escalation ownership and keep using manual review until assignments are corrected.

execution_order.title: Validate Teams Automation Alerts routes for overdue-review and daily-digest alert types.
execution_order.rollback: Disable Teams alerts and rely on in-app backlog visibility until routes are corrected.

execution_order.title: Run the internal operational-control sweep and verify backlog, overdue, exception, and escalation views.
execution_order.rollback: Disable the operational-control worker path and resolve schema or recipient issues.

manual_admin_checklist.step: Create or validate Teams Automation Alerts routes for client_intake_review_overdue, client_intake_escalated, and client_intake_daily_digest.
Enable MICROSOFT_365_CLIENT_INTAKE_OPERATIONS_ENABLED and strict validation for production.
Populate manager and department-lead escalation owners on active intake mappings.
Review the new operational diagnostics endpoint before opening broader reviewer rollout.

validation_checklist: Non-terminal submissions appear in the operational backlog view with stable dashboard links.
Waiting_on_client, paused, and manually_overridden states suppress escalation and reminder automation.
Overdue submissions escalate first to managers, then to department leads.
Teams Automation Alerts receives overdue and digest summaries when routes are configured.
Approval, rejection, revision request, assignment, and exception changes are durable and auditable.
rollback_principles: Disable MICROSOFT_365_CLIENT_INTAKE_OPERATIONS_ENABLED before changing escalation ownership or baseline thresholds in a live incident.
Do not clear exception states to hide backlog; use explicit reviewer decisions or notes.
Keep escalation failures visible in diagnostics until routes or recipients are fixed.
Pause mappings rather than widening automation when reviewer capacity is constrained.
